_doc: TrackerXXL control set: the single source of the plugin's host-visible parameters (tools/gen_controls.py writes params.json and build/ctl_table.h from this file). Order = VST parameter index: APPEND ONLY, never reorder. 'fw' names the firmware button enum in core/interface/core/interfaceDefs.h (mtInterfaceButtonsFunctions); the index is the value of that enum. A 'trigger' is a tap (press, auto-release after tap_ms); a 'latch' stays pressed while the host value is above 0.5 (modifiers such as SHIFT).

controls.name: DATA WHEEL
controls.doc: MPC data wheel on this control -> firmware encoder (onPotChange(0, clicks)): scrolls the selected row/list and changes the selected value. Endless: the value re-centres to 0.5 when it reaches an end.

controls.name: WHEEL +1
controls.doc: one encoder click forward (always works, no end stop)

controls.name: WHEEL -1
controls.doc: one encoder click back

controls.name: WHEEL PRESS
controls.doc: pressing the data wheel while the wheel control has the focus (skin action Enter Pressed): enter / open / select on the current screen

controls.name: PLAY
controls.doc: firmware PLAY: toggles play/stop of the pattern (functPlayAction)

controls.name: STOP
controls.doc: the firmware has no STOP key: this presses PLAY only while the sequencer is playing

controls.name: SHIFT
controls.doc: held while the host value is on (modifier)

controls.name: EDIT
controls.doc: the firmware's REC key = edit/record mode

controls.name: PAD COLUMNS
controls.doc: the 16 host pads are a 4x4 window of the firmware's 4x12 pad grid: which 4 columns. MPC pad k (0 = bottom-left) -> firmware row 3-(k/4), column PAD COLUMNS*4 + k%4

controls.name: HOST SYNC
controls.doc: ON: the firmware sequencer follows MPC's transport, tempo and song position (MIDI-clock path, config clock/transport input forced to USB). OFF: the firmware's own clock and PLAY.

controls.name: PAD MODE
controls.doc: the Force's 64 pads (MIDI notes 36-99, row-major from the bottom-left pad): PLAY = pads play the firmware pad grid (bottom 4 rows = grid columns 1-8, top 4 rows = columns 5-12); CONTROL = each pad is one Tracker button (fixed layout in docs/USER_GUIDE.md). Pad 8 (bottom-right, note 43) toggles the mode in both modes.
